summary: All lib content must be in lib/ansible, which may only contain .cs, .ps1, .psm1 and .py source files.
questions: Which file types are allowed under lib/ansible?

answer_card.title: no-unwanted-files
answer_card.answer_md: Everything in `lib` must be under `lib/ansible`, which only allows `*.cs`, `*.ps1`, `*.psm1` and `*.py`.
